scope: Accepted 74-screen specification and implementation acceptance ledger. Partial native UI work is recorded separately from complete screen/runtime acceptance.

binding_refinements: native system typography accent chrome; supplied artwork unchanged
SF and Fluent icons 16 to 20; modest headings; neutral surfaces; 8 16 24 spacing
one meaningful group; no nested cards pills healthy badges marketing headings developer copy or repeated policy text
keep essential operator permission trust release meaning
bottom actions reachable while body scrolls; no loading ellipses
focus first input; destructive default neutral or cancel; inline errors; safe draft retained; secrets cleared; honest measured progress
native window transitions only; no custom scale or timer
accessible light dark inactive high contrast motion text scaling
native keyboard and context menus; no canvas focus trap
preview sizes 192 256 320 default 448 per real account and deployment
Updates Delayed after 3s missing stream health; clear 5s; immediate clear on invalidation
Stop Control CmdShiftEscape Mac CtrlShiftF12 Win; CtrlTab exits canvas locally
release registry survives viewer close; Pending Release until ack or safe expiry
